verdicts.proof: Old: moto_filter_panel.dart:404-407 (chip tap sets category to null when already selected), filtering in catalog_provider.dart:285. v2: the only category control is MotoFilterPanelV2View, built by the same _MotoFilterPanelState for both the inline card (moto_filter_panel.dart:137-175) and the Filtry sheet (:117-133); moto_filter_panel_v2.dart:89-91 uses the same toggle and calls onCategory -> _set(_f.copyWith(category:)) (moto_filter_panel.dart:127/169). Selected chip is highlighted (MgChoiceChip selected). No other v2 writer of category found (grep for catalogFilterProvider writes in v2: only dates and branch).

Old: dropdown items from branchesProvider (catalog_provider.dart:436-460, closed branches skipped at :446), unknown value -> null at moto_filter_panel.dart:466-468. v2: chips from the same branchesProvider (moto_filter_panel.dart:121/163 -> moto_filter_panel_v2.dart:104-115), unknown id -> 'all' at moto_filter_panel_v2.dart:73-75; collapsed card shows branchName only when found (moto_filter_panel.dart:138-147). The other v2 branch writer, the calculator, also lists branchesProvider (calc_body_v2.dart:100, :204-212) and writes it to the filter via filterFromCalc (catalog_mode_sync.dart:80-81); its bike list skips closed branches (calc_state.dart:85-90). List itself still drops closed-branch bikes in filteredMotorcyclesProvider (catalog_provider.dart:410). Silent in both looks (closed branches simply absent).

Old rule now lives in _rangeModel (moto_filter_panel.dart:629-671): invalid bounds -> null (:638) and dropped by whereType (:624), out-of-bounds stored value -> no limit (:644-645), live drag kept locally and committed only onChangeEnd with ends = null (:660-668); filter in catalog_provider.dart:272-279, :308-318 unchanged vs 70a94933 (diff touches only availability timeouts). The old look draws the same model (_rangeSlider :674-699). v2 _InkRange (moto_filter_panel_v2.dart:171-211) passes m.onDrag/m.onDragEnd straight to RangeSlider (:205-206); no other v2 writer of min/max fields exists.

Old: Home calendar in panel (moto_filter_panel.dart:383-396) and Rezervovat calendar write start/end; filteredMotorcyclesProvider (catalog_provider.dart:401-429) drops closed branches (:410) and keeps only bikes passing motoAvailableForRange (:418-425; booking check fail-closed :120-124, service check fail-open :162-180). v2 writers of the dates: Home filter card calendar (moto_filter_panel.dart:149-158, same copyWith), Motorky dates card (motorky_dates_card_v2.dart:105-111 -> catSetDates/catClearDates, catalog_date_sheet_v2.dart same copyWith), Home funnel/date sheet (home_links.dart:34-37), calculator write-through (catalog_mode_sync.dart:98-110, :73-79). Every v2 list that shows bikes for dates reads filteredMotorcyclesProvider (motorky_screen_v2.dart:160, home_bike_list_v2.dart:69) or calls the same motoAvailableForRange with the closed-branch rule (funnel_provider.dart:146-165 via homeEligibleMotos :118; calc_state.dart:85-103). v2 additionally drops a remembered past range (catalog_mode_sync.dart:138-146). Dates shown as 'TERMÍN · d. m. – d. m.' on the Home card (moto_filter_card_v2.dart:132-142) and the count line 'Dostupné motorky: n · d dní' on Motorky (motorky_screen_v2.dart:217-235). Note: during the re-check after a date change both looks keep the previous list on screen (skipLoadingOnReload, old moto_search_screen.dart:211/226 at 70a94933); v2 additionally labels those stale cards 'Volná v termínu' - recorded under G-125.

verdicts.fix_idea: In motorky_screen_v2.dart:240-243 and home_bike_list_v2.dart:79/101-102 show 'Volná v termínu' only when the shown list was computed for the current dates: e.g. hasDates && !motosAsync.isLoading (pass motosAsync / isReloading into _list and HomeBikeListV2's data branch); while reloading show no pill (or the old availableToday rule). Old look and providers untouched.
verdicts.proof: Old: 'DNES VOLNÁ' only when moto.availableToday == true (moto_card.dart:168-169 at 70a94933), which is fail-closed (catalog_provider.dart:132-141); the old card made no claim about the chosen range. v2: Motorky card pill = hasDates ? 'Volná v termínu' : (availableToday == true ? 'Volná dnes' : none) (motorky_screen_v2.dart:240-243, drawn at moto_card_full_v2.dart:231-232); same on Home (home_bike_list_v2.dart:79, :101-102). hasDates is read from catalogFilterProvider synchronously (motorky_screen_v2.dart:161, home_bike_list_v2.dart:71), but the list comes from filteredMotorcyclesProvider rendered with skipLoadingOnReload: true (motorky_screen_v2.dart:184-187, home_bike_list_v2.dart:74-76). Concrete path: customer with no dates sees all bikes, picks a range in the Motorky dates card (or Home date sheet); while the per-bike check_moto_availability calls run (up to the 15 s timeout, catalog_provider.dart:111-113) the previous unfiltered list stays on screen and EVERY card, including busy and in-service bikes, carries 'Volná v termínu' and a price for the new range. Same when switching range A -> B. Tapping such a card opens the detail where the calendar/booking checks still apply, so it is a false display claim, not a booking bypass. With the list settled the pill is correct (list passed motoAvailableForRange). The 'Volná dnes' variant uses the same availableToday flag as before.

Old: licence badge when licenseGroupsOrFallback not empty, 'N' only -> catalogNoLicense, else prefix + groups without N (moto_card.dart:277-281, :402-410 at 70a94933); branch line when branchName != null (:297-317). v2: catLicenseLabel (catalog_text.dart:20-25) is the same rule, shown as a tag when non-empty (moto_card_full_v2.dart:118, :246); branch line catBranchLine (catalog_text.dart:72-77, falls back to branchCity, adds branch type) shown with a pin icon (moto_card_full_v2.dart:119, :249-256). Every v2 list card is MotoCardFullV2 (motorky_screen_v2.dart:255, home_bike_list_v2.dart:97). The funnel card shows the customer's own licence groups instead (home_funnel_v2.dart badge), and its list is already licence-filtered by BookingValidator.checkLicense (funnel_provider.dart:113-126). Minor: the licence tag is now second after the neon category tag and not colour-highlighted.

MotorkyScreenV2 header back -> context.go(Routes.home), menu -> context.go(Routes.profile) (motorky_screen_v2.dart:166-172), both protected. Router changes on the branch (resetPassword exception, Routes.protocol removal) apply to both looks and are outside this guard.
